description: Source code for the Nexus device identification implementation within the WPEFramework plugin, defining the DeviceImplementation class that retrieves device info such as chipset, firmware version, and unique identifier.

classes.name: DeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements device properties and identifier interfaces for Nexus hardware within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset information of the device.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version of the device.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device's unique identifier into a provided buffer.

methods.name: UpdateFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Updates the firmware version string based on platform version.

methods.name: UpdateChipset
methods.description: Updates the chipset string based on platform status.

methods.name: UpdateIdentifier
methods.description: Fetches and updates the device's unique identifier.
